questions.stem: Which of the following clinical features is most likely associated with severe Diabetic Ketoacidosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Venous pH between 7.25 and 7.35, alert patient

options.label: B
options.text: Venous CO2 between 16 and 20 mEq/L, patient with mild fatigue

options.label: C
options.text: Venous pH less than 7.15, patient with Kussmaul respirations and depressed sensorium

options.label: D
options.text: Venous CO2 between 10 and 15 mEq/L, patient who is sleepy but arousable
